title.es: Aquel del hermano oculto de Damián
title.en: The One With Damián's Hidden Sibling

description.es: Todos se preparan para la boda de Digna y Don Pedro. Mientras Begoña intenta elegir unos guantes, Marta la ayuda y le regala a Begoña el perfume especial que ella misma usa. Damián les dice a Marta y a Andrés que tiene un hermano del que nunca les habló y les anuncia que ha llegado Gabriel, el nieto de su hermano.
description.en: Everyone is getting ready for Digna and Don Pedro's wedding. As Begoña is trying to choose gloves, Marta helps her and gives Begoña the special perfume she wears herself as a gift. Damián tells Marta and Andrés that he has a sibling he never told them about and announces that Gabriel, his sibling's grandson, has arrived.
